sentences.en: Let me begin by explaining what it may look like to manage other people's emotions.
sentences.zh: 让我先解释一下管理别人的情绪可能会是什么样子。

sentences.en: Some of you probably don't need me to tell you.
sentences.zh: 你们中的一些人可能不需要我来告诉你们。

sentences.en: You feel it every day.
sentences.zh: 你们每天都能感受到。

sentences.en: But just to make it super clear what we're talking about here, I want to give a little bit of a peek behind the curtain, a little bit of a description.
sentences.zh: 但为了让我们讨论的内容超级清晰，我想稍微拉开一点帷幕，做一个简单的描述。

sentences.en: Managing other people's emotions,
sentences.zh: 管理别人的情绪，

sentences.en: it's not feeling bad for someone.
sentences.zh: 这并不是为某人感到难过。

sentences.en: One, it's not having empathy.
sentences.zh: 第一，这不是有同理心。

sentences.en: It's not expressing kindness.
sentences.zh: 这不是表达善意。

sentences.en: It's when we take on the responsibility of regulating someone else's internal state as if it were our own, often at the expense of our own emotions.
sentences.zh: 这是当我们承担起调节他人内心状态的责任时，就好像那是我们自己的一样，通常是以牺牲我们自己的情绪为代价的。

sentences.en: It's when someone else is sad, angry, disappointed, or even just in a bad mood, and we instinctively adjust our behavior, our mood, our tone,
sentences.zh: 这是当别人悲伤、愤怒、失望，甚至只是心情不好时，我们本能地调整自己的行为、情绪、语调，

sentences.en: or even our beliefs to soothe or appease them.
sentences.zh: 甚至是我们的信念，来安抚或取悦他们。

sentences.en: So it's not just about caring how someone else feels.
sentences.zh: 所以这不仅仅是关心别人的感受。

sentences.en: That's a very great natural human feeling and it should be promoted.
sentences.zh: 这是一种非常伟大自然的普通人类情感，应该被推崇。

sentences.en: It's basically trying to then control how they feel, believing that if we just say the right thing, if we fix the problem, if we're attentive enough, if we cheer them up,
sentences.zh: 这基本上是试图去控制他们的感受，坚信如果我们说对了话，如果我们解决了问题，如果我们足够体贴，如果我们让他们开心，

sentences.en: if we keep them calm, then everything is going to be okay.
sentences.zh: 如果我们让他们保持冷静，那么一切都会好起来的。

sentences.en: So it's beyond emotional awareness.
sentences.zh: 所以这超越了情绪觉察。

sentences.en: It's emotional overcompensating.
sentences.zh: 这是情绪过度补偿。

sentences.en: This looks like a lot of different things.
sentences.zh: 这表现为许多不同的形式。

sentences.en: It might look like over-explaining yourself to prevent someone from getting upset.
sentences.zh: 它可能看起来像是过度解释你自己，以防止某人生气。

sentences.en: It might feel like walking on eggshells or constantly anticipating how your words or your actions might be misinterpreted.
sentences.zh: 它可能感觉像是如履薄冰，或者不断预判你的言行可能会被如何误解。

sentences.en: It might mean putting your needs, your truth on hold to avoid setting someone off.
sentences.zh: 它可能意味着搁置你的需求、你的真相，以避免惹恼某人。

sentences.en: It might also look like, you know, being at an important event for yourself and constantly thinking about how someone else is feeling.
sentences.zh: 它也可能表现为，你知道的，在参加对你很重要的活动时，却一直在想着别人的感受。

sentences.en: Constantly monitoring their emotions to make sure they're okay, they're having fun, they're not upset, to the point where you just can't even enjoy yourself anymore.
sentences.zh: 不断监控他们的情绪，以确保他们没事、玩得很开心、没有心烦，直到你甚至无法再享受乐趣的程度。

sentences.en: The defining feature here is ownership.
sentences.zh: 这里的决定性特征是归属感。

sentences.en: You believe often unconsciously that their emotional response is your burden to carry and your job to fix.
sentences.zh: 你通常在无意识中相信，他们的情绪反应是你要背负的重担，也是你的工作去解决的问题。

sentences.en: I think it goes without saying, this can be incredibly draining because it places you in a constant state of hypervigilance.
sentences.zh: 我认为不言而喻的是，这会让人筋疲力尽，因为它让你处于持续的高度警惕状态。

sentences.en: Your nervous system starts to anticipate their dysregulation before it happens, therefore dysregulating you.
sentences.zh: 你的神经系统开始在他们情绪失调发生之前就进行预判，从而导致你自己也情绪失调。

sentences.en: You might catch yourself feeling guilty for things you didn't do or feeling responsible for problems you literally couldn't have prevented.
sentences.zh: 你可能会发现自己为没有做过的事情感到内疚，或者为那些你根本无法阻止的问题感到自责。

sentences.en: And what's more, this habit can actually disempower the people around you because it assumes that they can't manage their emotions without your intervention.
sentences.zh: 更重要的是，这种习惯实际上会削弱你身边人的能力，因为它假定他们在没有你介入的情况下就无法管理自己的情绪。

sentences.en: Sometimes what we're really doing is treating someone like a child.
sentences.zh: 有时候我们真正做的是把某人当作小孩子对待。

sentences.en: It's like we're putting ourselves in the position of a parent, even though they're an adult.
sentences.zh: 这就好像我们把自己放在了父母的位置上，尽管他们已经是成年人了。

sentences.en: They can experience hard things.
sentences.zh: 他们可以经历艰难的事情。

sentences.en: They can endure hard things.
sentences.zh: 他们可以承受艰难的事情。

sentences.en: They can learn from those hard things and still be okay.
sentences.zh: 他们可以从这些艰难的事情中学习，并且依然会好起来。

sentences.en: We often develop the belief that it is our responsibility to regulate others' emotions very, very young, very, very early on because of conditioning in childhood.
sentences.zh: 我们常常在很小很小的时候，由于童年时期的环境塑造，形成了一种信念，即调节他人的情绪是我们的责任。

sentences.en: People, many of us, grew up in environments where emotional expressions, especially negative ones like anger, sadness, or frustration, they were not just unpredictable,
sentences.zh: 我们中的许多人成长在这样的环境中：情感的表达，尤其是愤怒、悲伤或沮丧等负面情绪，不仅不可预测，

sentences.en: sometimes they were unsafe.
sentences.zh: 有时甚至是不安全的。

sentences.en: When a caregiver's mood dictated the tone of the household, children learn to scan rapidly for emotional shifts and preemptively manage them in order to maintain a sense of safety.
sentences.zh: 当照顾者的情绪决定了家庭的基调时，孩子们就会学会迅速扫描情绪的变化并先发制人地进行管理，以维持一种安全感。

sentences.en: In such cases, you know, a child often internalizes a very distorted sense of control, basically along the lines of, if I can keep them happy, everything will be okay.
sentences.zh: 在这种情况下，你知道的，孩子往往会将一种非常扭曲的控制感内化，基本上沿着这样的思路：如果我能让他们保持快乐，一切都会好起来的。

sentences.en: Over time, this morphs into a very deeply ingrained belief that other people's emotions are their personal responsibility.
sentences.zh: 随着时间的推移，这演变成了一种根深蒂固的信念，即别人的情绪是他们个人的责任。

sentences.en: This conditioning often manifests itself later as, drumroll please,
sentences.zh: 这种条件反射后来往往表现为，请敲击鼓点，

sentences.en: people-pleasing.
sentences.zh: 取悦他人。

sentences.en: People-pleasing, a lot of people don't know this, is actually a coping mechanism.
sentences.zh: 讨好他人，很多人不知道这一点，其实是一种应对机制。

sentences.en: It's a coping mechanism rooted in a fear of rejection and rooted in a fear of disapproval.
sentences.zh: 这是一种根植于对拒绝的恐惧和对不赞同的恐惧的应对机制。

sentences.en: People-pleasers often overextend themselves emotionally, not just to be liked, that's only one component of this, but to avoid the discomfort of someone else's negative reactions.
sentences.zh: 讨好者往往在情感上过度付出，不仅仅是为了被喜欢，这只是其中的一个组成部分，而是为了避免面对别人负面反应带来的不适感。

sentences.en: According to psychologist
sentences.zh: 根据心理学家

sentences.en: Harriet B.
sentences.zh: 哈丽特·B

sentences.en: Breaker, she's the author of
sentences.zh: Breaker的说法，她是

sentences.en: The Disease to Please, this behavior stems from a need for external validation and also a subconscious belief that one's worth is tied to being agreeable, accommodating,
sentences.zh: 《The Disease to Please》的作者，这种行为源于对外部认可的需求，也源于一种潜意识信念，即一个人的价值与随和、迁就，

sentences.en: and most importantly, conflict-free.
sentences.zh: 以及最重要的是没有冲突挂钩。

sentences.en: When someone gets upset, the people-pleaser, it's not just that they don't want to witness the emotion, it's that they absorb it and they believe it's their duty to fix it,
sentences.zh: 当有人生气时，讨好者不仅不想看到这种情绪，而且他们会将其吸收，并认为解决它是自己的职责，

sentences.en: even when they have absolutely no part in causing it.
sentences.zh: 即使他们跟这件事的起因完全没有任何关系。

sentences.en: This self-imposed kind of responsibility becomes exhausting.
sentences.zh: 这种强加给自己的责任变得令人筋疲力尽。

sentences.en: It often reinforces as well a cycle of hidden self-neglect.
sentences.zh: 它往往还会强化一种隐秘的自我忽视的循环。

sentences.en: Let's talk about gender.
sentences.zh: 我们来谈谈性别。

sentences.en: Let's talk about gender when it comes to managing other people's emotions because gender socialization definitely complicates this pattern.
sentences.zh: 当涉及到管理别人的情绪时，我们来谈谈性别，因为性别社会化绝对会让这种模式变得更加复杂。

sentences.en: Women in particular are often raised to be caretakers, not just of others, but of their emotions.
sentences.zh: 尤其是女性，通常被培养成照顾者，不仅要照顾别人，还要照顾他们的情绪。

sentences.en: They are encouraged, even subliminally, to be empathetic, nurturing, to be very sensitive to other people's needs.
sentences.zh: 她们受到鼓励，甚至是在潜意识里，要富有同理心、有养育能力，对别人的需求高度敏感。

sentences.en: Boys, on the other hand, are typically taught to suppress emotions or to handle them independently.
sentences.zh: 另一方面，男孩通常被教导要压抑情绪或独立处理情绪。

sentences.en: Both people lose in this situation.
sentences.zh: 在这种情况下，双方都是输家。

sentences.en: Both genders are losing.
sentences.zh: 两种性别都在输。

sentences.en: As a result, many women grow up with kind of an invisible curriculum that teaches them their job is to smooth things over, it is to regulate tension, it's to serve as kind of
sentences.zh: 结果就是，许多女性成长时带有一种无形的课程，教导她们的工作是平息事端、调节紧张局势，充当某种

sentences.en: emotional support systeMs.
sentences.zh: 情感支持系统。

sentences.en: I think this disproportionate expectation, it's not an innate thing.
sentences.zh: 我认为这种不相称的期望并不是天生的。

sentences.en: We're not born with it.
sentences.zh: 我们生来并非如此。

sentences.en: It's definitely cultural and it's led to a phenomenon known in psychology and beyond as emotional labor, where one person becomes the designated feeler, the designated fixer,
sentences.zh: 这绝对是文化的产物，它导致了心理学及其他领域中被称为情感劳动的现象，即一个人成为指定的感受者、指定的解决问题者，

sentences.en: especially in relationships, at the cost of their own mental and emotional well-being.
sentences.zh: 尤其是在亲密关系中，代价是牺牲他们自己的心理和情感健康。

sentences.en: They do more labor when it comes to holding up other people's feelings and protecting their feelings.
sentences.zh: 当涉及到维系别人的感受和保护他们的感受时，他们付出了更多的心力。

sentences.en: Think at its core, believing we are responsible for other people's emotions sometimes reflects a lack of healthy emotional boundaries.
sentences.zh: 我想其核心在于，认为我们要对别人的情绪负责，有时反映了缺乏健康的心理边界。

sentences.en: And this is often shaped by trauma, it's shaped by unmet needs, it's shaped by the past, it's shaped by subconscious fears.
sentences.zh: 这通常是由创伤塑造的，由未满足的需求塑造的，由过去塑造的，由潜意识的恐惧塑造的。

sentences.en: From a psychological standpoint, this belief really blows the lines between what we call enmeshment and empathy.
sentences.zh: 从心理学的角度来看，这种信念确实模糊了我们所说的缠结与同理心之间的界限。

sentences.en: Empathy is great.
sentences.zh: 同理心是件好事。

sentences.en: Empathy allows us to feel with someone else.
sentences.zh: 同理心让我们能够感同身受。

sentences.en: It allows us to see things from their perspective and be compassionate.
sentences.zh: 它让我们能够从他们的角度看待事物并富有同情心。

sentences.en: Enmeshment, on the other hand, traps us in feeling for them.
sentences.zh: 另一方面，缠结则让我们深陷于替他们感受。

sentences.en: It becomes hard to differentiate with enmeshment when their emotions end and ours begin.
sentences.zh: 在缠结的状态下，很难分辨他们的情绪何时结束、我们的情绪何时开始。

sentences.en: This is also very costly to our relationships, I think that goes without saying.
sentences.zh: 我想不言而喻的是，这对我们的关系也代价高昂。

sentences.en: To us, managing other people's emotions might feel like devotion, it might feel like sacrifice and kindness.
sentences.zh: 对我们来说，管理别人的情绪可能感觉像是奉献、牺牲和善良。

sentences.en: All things we were taught are very valuable to display in a relationship.
sentences.zh: 所有这些都是我们被教导在关系中展现出来非常有价值的东西。

sentences.en: But love doesn't require us to be emotional shock absorbers.
sentences.zh: 但爱并不要求我们成为情感减震器。

sentences.en: Real intimacy doesn't thrive in a relationship where one person is always managing the other person.
sentences.zh: 真正的亲密关系无法在一个总是由一个人管理另一个人的关系中蓬勃发展。

sentences.en: And so, they end up feeling resentful and burnt out and they end up feeling kind of like a bit of a quiet grief for what they're missing out on in a relationship.
sentences.zh: 因此，他们最终会感到怨恨和筋疲力尽，并且对于自己在亲密关系中错失的东西感到一种无声的悲伤。

sentences.en: Ironically, I think it also stunts genuine closeness because you guys know this true connection isn't built on emotional performance, it's not built on perfection, it's built on
sentences.zh: 具有讽刺意味的是，我认为这也阻碍了真正的亲密，因为你们都知道，真正的连接不是建立在情感表演之上的，不是建立在完美之上的，而是建立在

sentences.en: real deep honesty and intimacy and hard moments and autonomy but also on mutual recognition.
sentences.zh: 真实而深刻的诚实、亲密、艰难的时刻、自主性以及相互认可之上的。

sentences.en: Both people are able to come to the table with their baggage and you sort through it together rather than just one person taking over.
sentences.zh: 双方都能带着各自的包袱来到谈判桌前，你们一起解决问题，而不是由一个人独揽大权。

sentences.en: Listen, I want to say it's not that you're being cruel, quite the opposite, and it's not like you can't help someone with what they're going through or help them with a bad day.
sentences.zh: 听着，我想说的是，这并不是说你在残忍对待别人，恰恰相反，这也不是说你不能在别人经历困境或度过糟糕的一天时给予帮助。

sentences.en: What I'm saying is when this becomes your biggest and only priority, it can become harmful.
sentences.zh: 我想说的是，当这成为你最大也是唯一的优先事项时，它就会变得有害。

sentences.en: Holding space for someone else's emotions without shrinking ourselves really starts with understanding that empathy and self-abandonment are not the same thing.
sentences.zh: 在不缩小自我的前提下为别人的情绪留出空间，真正始于理解同理心和自我抛弃并不是同一回事。

sentences.en: True empathy, the kind we really want to celebrate, means being with someone in their emotional experience, not absorbing it, not fixing it, not making yourself small
sentences.zh: 真正的同理心，也就是我们真正想要歌颂的那种，意味着陪伴某人经历他们的情感体验，而不是去吸收它、去修复它、去让自己变得渺小

sentences.en: so they can be okay.
sentences.zh: 好让他们感觉好些。

sentences.en: It means saying I see this, I see you, I hear you,
sentences.zh: 这意味着说我看到了这个，我看到了你，我听到了你，

sentences.en: I'm here, without saying
sentences.zh: 我在这里，而不是说

sentences.en: I'm going to take this all away, without taking their pain on you as your own personal sacrifice.
sentences.zh: 我会把这一切都带走，而不是把他们的痛苦当作你个人的牺牲来承担。

sentences.en: This requires emotional boundaries, it requires the ability to care without carrying and just to listen, just listen and be present.
sentences.zh: 这需要情绪边界，需要关怀而不背负的能力，只需倾听，只需倾听并保持存在。

sentences.en: A key part of this is also just checking in with your nervous system when you're supporting others because often it is an instinct to jump right in and then want to fix everything
sentences.zh: 这其中的关键部分还在于，在支持他人时审视一下你自己的神经系统，因为通常本能反应就是直接跳进去，然后想要修复一切。

sentences.en: and then to see your own nervous system and your own stress response spike.
sentences.zh: 然后看着自己的神经系统和压力反应急剧飙升。

sentences.en: So really ask yourself, am I grounded?
sentences.zh: 所以请认真问问自己，我稳住自己了吗？

sentences.en: Do I feel safe?
sentences.zh: 我觉得安全吗？

sentences.en: Am I abandoning my own needs or values in this moment?
sentences.zh: 此刻我是否为了迎合别人而放弃了自己的需求或价值观？

sentences.en: Is this upsetting me such that I can't enjoy my own experiences?
sentences.zh: 这件事是不是让我心烦意乱到无法享受自己的生活？

sentences.en: If the answer is yes, it's a sign you may be overextending and overcompensating.
sentences.zh: 如果答案是肯定的，这说明你可能付出过多、过度妥协了。

sentences.en: So in those moments, please remind yourself, their feelings are totally valid but they are also not mine to fix.
sentences.zh: 所以在那些时刻，请提醒自己，他们的感受完全合理，但这并不是我的责任去解决。

sentences.en: This person is fully capable of managing their own emotions with my help.
sentences.zh: 在我的帮助下，这个人完全有能力处理好自己的情绪。

sentences.en: I don't need to fix it, I just need to be there with them.
sentences.zh: 我不需要去修复它，我只需要陪伴在他们身边。

sentences.en: It also means practicing honest communication which I know can be so hard for those of us who are conflict averse.
sentences.zh: 这也意味着要践行诚实的沟通，我知道对于我们这些抗拒冲突的人来说，这真的很难。

sentences.en: I personally really struggle with this.
sentences.zh: 我个人在这方面真的很挣扎。

sentences.en: I don't want to stir the pot.
sentences.zh: 我不想惹事生非。

sentences.en: I don't want to make things more difficult so I just ignore
sentences.zh: 我不想把事情搞得更复杂，所以我选择直接忽视

sentences.en: phrases that you can practice, you can bring into your vocabulary that can really help you out.
sentences.zh: 一些你可以练习的短语，你可以把它们加入到你的日常词汇中，这真的能帮到你。

sentences.en: You can say things like, I really want to be here for you but I also need a moment to catch my breath or I care about how you're feeling and I want to support you but I don't want
sentences.zh: 你可以这样说，我真的很想陪着你，但我也需要一点时间喘口气，或者我在乎你的感受，我也想支持你，但我不想

sentences.en: to lose myself in the process.
sentences.zh: 在这个过程中迷失自我。

sentences.en: This kind of emotional honesty, it's really vulnerable, it's hard but it also sets a powerful tone and boundary.
sentences.zh: 这种情感上的坦诚，真的非常脆弱、很难做到，但它也定下了一个强有力的基调和界限。

sentences.en: I love you but I'm not going to martyr myself for you.
sentences.zh: 我爱你，但我不会为了你而牺牲自己。

sentences.en: In fact, I think it also makes the bond between you stronger.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我认为这也会让你们之间的纽带更加牢固。

sentences.en: If they're used to asking you for things all the time, this is you asking them for something.
sentences.zh: 如果他们习惯了总是向你索取，这就是你在向他们提出要求。

sentences.en: It levels out the playing field.
sentences.zh: 这拉平了双方的地位。

sentences.en: Also, and I know it's going to feel strange doing this,
sentences.zh: 另外，我知道这样做会感觉有点怪，

sentences.en: but sometimes you just have to let them be angry and just to watch that feeling and let them be tired, let them be hungry,
sentences.zh: 但有时你就是得让他们去生气，去看着那种情绪，让他们去感到疲惫，让他们去感到饥饿，

sentences.en: let them make mistakes and then let them help themselves.
sentences.zh: 让他们犯错，然后让他们自己帮助自己。

sentences.en: If someone truly doesn't know how to self-regulate, you're not helping them any further by keeping them dependent on you.
sentences.zh: 如果一个人真的不知道如何自我调节，你让他们继续依赖你，并不是在帮他们。

sentences.en: You think you're helping, you are hurting them if they genuinely don't have the skills to do this.
sentences.zh: 你以为你在帮忙，但如果他们根本不具备这种能力，你其实是在伤害他们。

sentences.en: I think what this mantra really invites us to do is just to examine the ways that we've internalized responsibility for other people's emotional states and just to question,
sentences.zh: 我认为这个座右铭真正邀请我们去做的，只是审视我们是如何将照顾他人情绪状态的责任内化到自己身上，并去质疑，

sentences.en: is that responsibility ever truly ours?
sentences.zh: 这种责任真的是我们的吗？

sentences.en: It's not about indifference, it's about recognizing the limits of our role in someone else's inner world.
sentences.zh: 这不是冷漠，而是认清我们在别人内心世界中所扮演角色的局限。

sentences.en: We can't get into their brain and switch on different switches.
sentences.zh: 我们无法钻进他们的脑子里去按动不同的开关。

sentences.en: We have to just sometimes view what's going on from the outside.
sentences.zh: 有时我们必须从局外人的角度去看待正在发生的事情。

sentences.en: Okay, we are going to take a short little break, but afterwards
sentences.zh: 好了，我们要稍微休息一下，但接下来

sentences.en: I'm going to share with you all how this has shown up in my own life, especially recently.
sentences.zh: 我要和大家分享这在我的生活中是如何体现的，尤其是最近。

sentences.en: What I've learned, where I've struggled, what I'm still figuring out.
sentences.zh: 我学到了什么，我在哪里感到了挣扎，我还在摸索什么。

sentences.en: Stay with us.
sentences.zh: 请继续收听。

sentences.en: Okay, now that we've looked at the meaning behind today's mantra,
sentences.zh: 好了，既然我们已经探讨了今天座右铭背后的含义，

sentences.en: I'm not here to manage other people's emotions.
sentences.zh: 我来这里不是为了管理别人的情绪。

sentences.en: It's time to get personal with you guys and share some of my own insights and reflections about this phrase.
sentences.zh: 是时候和大家深入交流一下，分享一些我个人对这句话的见解和反思了。

sentences.en: The place and the spaces where I feel most responsible for other people's emotions is in big group situations, and
sentences.zh: 我感到最需要对别人的情绪负责的地方和空间，就是在大群体的聚会中，而且

sentences.en: I'm sure a lot of you can relate to this.
sentences.zh: 我确信你们很多人都能感同身受。

sentences.en: When I have invited people to my house, when
sentences.zh: 当我邀请别人来我家时，当

sentences.en: I'm away on a trip with my girlfriends, when
sentences.zh: 我和闺蜜们一起去旅行时，当

sentences.en: I'm hanging out with a big group of people, I always feel like I have to make sure everyone is having fun, everyone is enjoying themselves, not a single person can feel left
sentences.zh: 我和一大群人一起闲逛时，我总是觉得我必须确保每个人都玩得很开心，每个人都在享受其中，绝对不能有任何人感到被

sentences.en: out or feel bored or feel any sort of bad feeling, and if they do, that is terrible.
sentences.zh: 冷落、感到无聊或产生任何不好的感觉，如果有的话，那就太糟糕了。

sentences.en: I have failed as a host, I have failed as a friend.
sentences.zh: 作为主人我失败了，作为朋友我失败了。

sentences.en: I don't really know when I first learned to do this, I just kind of know that I always have.
sentences.zh: 我其实记不清自己是从什么时候开始学会这样的，我只知道我一直都是这样。

sentences.en: Since I was very young, I think I saw discomfort, conflict, so called negative emotions as kind of a threat, especially if someone else was feeling them, I thought that how they
sentences.zh: 我很小的时候起，就把不适、冲突、所谓的负面情绪视为一种威胁，尤其是当别人有这种情绪时，我认为他们的

sentences.en: were feeling was a reflection of the emotional environment I was creating in that moment.
sentences.zh: 感受正是我当时所营造的情感环境的反映。

sentences.en: What that doesn't recognize is that people are going to come into a situation with all kinds of emotional baggage, all kinds of stuff that's annoyed them and frustrated them from
sentences.zh: 这种想法没有认识到的是，人们来到一个环境中时，会带着各种各样情感包袱，带着一天下来让他们感到恼火和沮丧的各种情绪，

sentences.en: their day, all kind of stuff from their paSt.
sentences.zh: 带着过去的种种经历。

sentences.en: I feel like sometimes when we try to regulate other people's emotions, we kind of have this somewhat
sentences.zh: 我觉得有时当我们试图调节别人的情绪时，我们有点像有一种

sentences.en: God-complex that we are that significant in this person's life, that we could change their feelings more than the combination of everything else that's going on with them, which
sentences.zh: 上帝情结，觉得自己在这个人的生命中是如此重要，以至于我们能够改变他们的感受，其分量超过了他们身上正在发生的其他一切事情的总和，而这

sentences.en: is not true.
sentences.zh: 是不可能的。

sentences.en: I was talking about where I first learned to do this, and I do think upon further reflection, probably in my case it has to do with being an eldest daughter.
sentences.zh: 我刚才在谈论我是从哪里开始学会这样的，经过进一步反思，我确实觉得对我和而言，这可能与我是个大女儿有关。

sentences.en: Being an eldest daughter, I'm sure a lot of you, eldest daughters, relate, it often really intensifies the pressure to manage other people's emotions because from an
sentences.zh: 作为一个大女儿，我相信你们很多大女儿都会感同身受，管理他人情绪的压力往往会大大加剧，因为从

sentences.en: early age, a lot of us are cast into the role of emotional anchor, caretaker, third parent, whether explicitly or kind of asked or silently expected, we are often the ones
sentences.zh: 很小的时候起，我们中的许多人就被推入了情感锚点、照顾者、第三个家长的角色中，无论是以明示的方式，还是被要求或默默期待，我们往往都是

sentences.en: who smooth over conflict, we look after younger siblings, we support overwhelmed parents, and sometimes we do set the emotional tone for the household.
sentences.zh: 那个平息冲突的人，我们照顾弟弟妹妹，我们支持精疲力竭的父母，有时我们确实为整个家庭奠定了情感基调。

sentences.en: So it's not just about a sense of responsibility, it's about invisible labor, a form of emotional and relational work that a lot of women do that often goes unnoticed
sentences.zh: 所以这不仅仅是一种责任感，这是一种无形的劳动，是一种很多女性都在做的情感和关系方面的工作，这种工作往往不被人注意，

sentences.en: but really shapes how we as eldest daughters come to see ourselves, that this role as caretaker is part of our identity, everything and everyone must be happy, safe, together.
sentences.zh: 但它确实塑造了我们作为大女儿如何看待自己，让我们觉得照顾者的角色是我们身份的一部分，每个人每件事都必须快乐、安全、和睦。

sentences.en: This early emotional caregiving thing, as I said, does become part of our identity, we learn to anticipate the needs of others before their own needs even register, sometimes
sentences.zh: 正如我所说，这种早期对情感的照顾确实成了我们身份的一部分，我们学会了在别人的需求甚至还没意识到之前就去预测它们，有时

sentences.en: we might actually
sentences.zh: 我们甚至可能

sentences.en: enjoy it a little bit.
sentences.zh: 还有点乐在其中。

sentences.en: I know this is going to sound strange but we might really kind of revel in the fact that we are so helpful and revel in the fact that we are so emotionally aware because that's
sentences.zh: 我知道这听起来可能很奇怪，但我们可能会为自己如此乐于助人而感到沾沾自喜，为自己如此具有情感觉察力而暗自得意，因为这也是

sentences.en: another component of this.
sentences.zh: 其中的另一个组成部分。

sentences.en: People who feel like they have to manage other people's emotions are often incredibly emotionally intelligent and incredibly emotionally perceptive.
sentences.zh: 觉得自己必须管理他人情绪的人，通常在情感上极其聪明，对情绪有着极高的感知力。

sentences.en: that feels like a good thing because it is, that feels like a positive attribute and a positive quality.
sentences.zh: 这感觉像是一件好事，因为它的确是，这感觉像是一种积极的特质和品质。

sentences.en: So it's hard to disentangle where that quality becomes quite negative and dangerous because if we've only grown up or taught ourselves to see this as a positive trait and
sentences.zh: 所以很难理清这种品质究竟在哪个节点变得非常负面和危险，因为如果我们从小到大受到的教育或自我训练都是将此视为一种积极的特质，

sentences.en: as something that should be celebrated, recognizing the downsides of this is very hard because it means recognizing that perhaps not that we have flaws but there are some
sentences.zh: 是应该被赞美的品质，那么要认识到它的缺点是非常困难的，因为这意味着我们要承认，也许不是我们身上有缺陷，而是我们的身份

sentences.en: downsides to our identity.
sentences.zh: 存在一些缺点。

sentences.en: As adults as well, a lot of eldest daughters, a lot of people who fill this position may find themselves in friendships or romantic relationships where again they
sentences.zh: 成年后也是如此，许多大女儿、许多处于这个位置的人可能会发现自己身处这样的友谊或恋爱关系中，在那里他们

sentences.en: just keep replaying and revising the same role, the role of fixer, peacemaker, therapist, at some point not because they want to anymore but because again it feels
sentences.zh: 只是不断地重演和修正着同一个角色——修复者、和事佬、治疗师的角色。他们这样做在某种程度上已经不是因为他们还想这么做，而是因为再次觉得

sentences.en: natural because love to them has meant doing more, being more, absorbing more, managing more.
sentences.zh: 这一切都很自然，因为对他们来说，爱意味着付出更多、表现得更好、承受更多、管理更多。

sentences.en: The consequences of this have become a lot more apparent the older I've become.
sentences.zh: 随着我年龄的增长，这些后果变得越来越明显。

sentences.en: Tell me if you relate to these feelings.
sentences.zh: 如果你们也有同感，请告诉我。

sentences.en: I feel like I always feel stressed in social situations.
sentences.zh: 我觉得自己在社交场合总是感到压力山大。

sentences.en: I have less fun.
sentences.zh: 我觉得没那么开心。

sentences.en: I always feel like I'm the person having the least fun sometimes.
sentences.zh: 有时候我总觉得自己是那个玩得最不开心的人。

sentences.en: I also feel resentment towards people that don't deserve it.
sentences.zh: 我对那些不该承受这些的人也产生了怨恨。

sentences.en: I'm the one who has put them in the position where they have been forced to kind of rely on me.
sentences.zh: 是我把他们置于不得不依赖我的境地。

sentences.en: I'm the one who has tried to control the emotional tone of the situation.
sentences.zh: 是我试图控制当时的情感基调。

sentences.en: It's my fault in a sense.
sentences.zh: 从某种意义上说，这是我的错。

sentences.en: Part of this also is that I avoid things that need to be said.
sentences.zh: 部分原因还在于，我总是逃避那些需要说出口的话。

sentences.en: I'm also a very sensitive person and if someone is even slightly upset or mad I believe that they are upset or mad at me and that can be very devastating.
sentences.zh: 我也是一个非常敏感的人，如果有人哪怕只有一点点沮丧或生气，我也会认为他们是在生我的气，这会让我感到非常崩溃。

sentences.en: So when there are things that actually need to be said and that would actually improve our friendship or our relationship I just don't say them.
sentences.zh: 所以当有些话确实需要说出来，并且这些话实际上能改善我们的友谊或关系时，我偏偏就不说。

sentences.en: I would prefer the lesser discomfort of being hyper-vigilant towards their emotional reactions than a full-blown conflict.
sentences.zh: 比起全面爆发的冲突，我宁愿选择对他们的情绪反应保持高度警惕所带来的那种轻微的不适感。

sentences.en: Something I've learnt probably in the last couple of years is that avoiding conflict is A, sometimes a sign of emotional immaturity that you don't think you can handle big
sentences.zh: 我可能在过去几年里学到的一点是，逃避冲突，A，有时是情感不成熟的表现，说明你觉得自己无法应对巨大的

sentences.en: emotions so you avoid them.
sentences.zh: 情绪，所以你选择逃避。

sentences.en: B, it's also 99 to
sentences.zh: B，它在99%到

sentences.en: 100% of the time going to make your relationship suffer more.
sentences.zh: 100%的情况下都会让你的关系遭受更多痛苦。

sentences.en: This quote, what I think is saying to me is, I believe you are capable of holding your own sadness, your own anger, your own uncertainty, even when it's hard.

sentences.zh: 为什么他们的情绪比你的更重要？

sentences.en: How come you are fully responsible for your emotions but you can't recognize that other people can be fully responsible for theirs as well?
sentences.zh: 为什么你可以完全对自己的情绪负责，却不能认识到别人也可以完全对他们自己的情绪负责？

sentences.en: This is not about ignoring people, neglecting people, not offering a helping hand when you see them struggling.
sentences.zh: 这并不是要忽视别人、冷落别人，也不是在你看到他们挣扎时拒绝伸出援手。

sentences.en: It's about this not being the status quo for you.
sentences.zh: 这是关于让这不再成为你的常态。

sentences.en: This not being the only way you can help someone.
sentences.zh: 这不再成为你帮助别人的唯一方式。

sentences.en: If you take one thing away from this episode, let it be this, you are not here to regulate the emotional weather around you.
sentences.zh: 如果你能从这期节目中带走一样东西，那就让它是这个：你不是来调节你周遭的情感天气的。

sentences.en: You are here to live in alignment with your values, your truth, your peace that's going to make you a better friend, it's going to make your relationship stronger, I promise you
sentences.zh: 你是为了与你的价值观、你的真相、你的平静保持一致而活着，这会让你成为一个更好的朋友，会让你的关系更牢固，我向你保证

sentences.en: that.
sentences.zh: 这一点。

sentences.en: Letting go of the need to manage other people's emotions, it's not selfish.
sentences.zh: 放手对管理他人情绪的需求，这并不自私。

sentences.en: It's actually very helpful for them as well to learn and to feel their own personal sense of emotional autonomy and personal responsibility.
sentences.zh: 实际上，这对他们学习并感受到属于他们自己的情感自主权和个人责任感也大有裨益。

sentences.en: This week and beyond, celebrate that return, honour that return, and trust that when you do, what's real is going to remain and you're going to be okay.
sentences.zh: 在本周及未来，庆祝这种回归，尊崇这种回归，并坚信当你这样做时，真实的东西会留下来，而你会安然无恙。
